jobs.title: General Manager, UK & Ireland
jobs.description:
At Deliverect, our API-first platform is revolutionizing commerce by providing a connected suite of on and off-premise solutions. We empower both the food and retail industries to expand their revenue and simplify their operations, creating seamless experiences for businesses to sell anywhere and deliver everywhere. Join us in this exciting journey, where your contributions will directly impact how businesses connect with their customers in a rapidly evolving global market.


Your Impact:
Join Deliverect, a market-leading software company transforming how restaurants, QSR, grocery and retail businesses manage digital ordering and commerce. We are looking for an experienced General Manager, UK & Ireland to lead Deliverect’s commercial performance and market strategy across the region.
This is a broad, hands-on leadership role spanning new business, account management, partnerships and customer success. You will lead the regional team, drive major enterprise opportunities and ensure we continue to develop strong customers and strategic partnerships.
Based from our London office, you will also provide leadership across the wider UK & Ireland organisation, bringing teams together around clear priorities, performance and market opportunities. 
This is a full-time, London based role, with regular presence in Deliverect's London Office.

What You Will Do:
-
Own and execute the UK & Ireland strategy , covering commercial growth, customer satisfaction, partnerships and market development.

-
Lead teams across New Business, Account Management and Partnerships , setting clear priorities and driving performance.

-
Lead major enterprise opportunities, RFPs and tenders across restaurant, QSR, grocery, convenience and retail.

-
Build strong relationships with key customers, driving retention, satisfaction and account growth .

-
Develop Deliverect’s partner ecosystem , including POS providers, technology partners, delivery platforms and other strategic partners.

-
Remain hands-on in key opportunities, supporting proposition development, commercial negotiations and deal closure.

-
Own regional pipeline, forecasting, account planning and customer performance.

-
Work closely with Product, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Implementation, Customer Success, Finance and Legal , ensuring UK & Ireland priorities are represented across the business.

-
Use customer, partner and market feedback to help shape Deliverect’s product and go-to-market strategy.

-
Provide visible leadership within the London office , including regular UK & Ireland All Hands sessions and broader team alignment.

-
Coach and develop the regional commercial team, creating clear ownership and accountability.

-
Represent Deliverect at key customer, partner and industry engagements.
What You Will Bring:
-
Strong commercial leadership experience within B2B SaaS, enterprise technology or a related environment .

-
Experience leading teams across new business, account management and partnerships .

-
Proven track record of developing and closing complex enterprise opportunities , including RFP and tender processes.

-
Experience building and developing strategic customer and partner relationships.

-
Strong commercial judgement, balancing new business growth with customer retention and expansion.

-
Understanding of technology integrations, APIs, POS ecosystems, digital ordering, commerce and/or last-mile delivery.

-
Strong analytical skills across pipeline, forecasting, customer performance and market development.

-
Collaborative and comfortable working across multiple departments and global teams.

-
A hands-on leadership style , able to move between strategy, team leadership and direct commercial involvement.
Additional Information:
-
This is a full-time, London-based role , with regular presence in Deliverect’s London office.

-
Travel across the UK & Ireland will be required, alongside occasional international travel.

-
The role has leadership responsibility across New Business, Account Management and Partnerships .

-
You will combine regional strategy with hands-on execution, while ensuring the UK & Ireland market is strongly represented within Deliverect’s wider global organisation.
Join Our Innovative Journey:

At Deliverect, we're not just building a platform; we're redefining how restaurants and retailers connect with their customers globally. We're looking for agile, ambitious, and resourceful team members who are excited to tackle complex challenges, take calculated risks and contribute to innovative solutions that shape the future of commerce.

What You'll Gain by Joining Us:

Invest in Your Growth- We provide a dedicated learning budget to help you expand your skills and knowledge in this dynamic environment.
Solve Meaningful Challenges- Contribute to tackling some of the most significant challenges in the global tech industry, directly impacting the way businesses operate worldwide.
Drive Innovation- Immerse yourself in a culture where innovation isn't just a buzzword – our weekly releases and new features ensure you're always working on cutting-edge solutions.
Collaborate with a Global Team- Be part of a diverse, international team that values transparency, visibility, and a multitude of perspectives.
Be Part of a Unicorn- Join a rapidly scaling SaaS unicorn at the forefront of the order management industry, where your contributions have significant impact.
Enjoy Regionally Tailored Rewards- Our compensation and benefits packages are thoughtfully designed to reflect the unique needs of each market, ensuring you’re supported with what matters most—right where you are.

Our Commitment to Inclusion:

We are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and has equal opportunities to succeed. We strongly encourage applications from underrepresented groups.

2. Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the role is based, as we are currently unable to provide financial assistance for relocation or travel.

The Cloud Platform department at Deliverect is the engine that drives our customers' success by providing a reliable, scalable, and secure platform for exceptional customer experiences. Our team of passionate engineers and architects constantly innovates and refines our solutions, equipping businesses with the cutting-edge technology they need to thrive in today's competitive landscape and deliver unparalleled ordering experiences.
Your Impact:
As the Head of IT and Procurement, you will lead our global IT infrastructure and vendor management strategy, playing a pivotal role in optimising our internal operations. You will design and execute strategies to streamline global hardware provisioning, negotiate SaaS contracts, and ensure our global teams have the secure tools they need to succeed in our high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

This is a full-time, hybrid role with a flexible work schedule, offering 3 days in either our Madrid, London or Ghent, Belgium office and 2 days from the comfort of your home.

What you will do:
-
Strategic IT Leadership (approx. 25%): Execute a global IT strategy aligned with company growth plans. Partner with leaders to drive operational excellence, and scalable processes for employee IT journey.

-
Procurement & Vendor Management (approx. 30%): Own and refine the end-to-end software and hardware procurement lifecycle. Negotiate enterprise contracts for our internal GTM and engineering stack to maximise ROI and ensure budget predictability.

-
Systems Administration & Security (approx. 20%): Establish data governance frameworks to ensure accuracy, reliability, and compliance across all internal systems. Partner with the Security team to implement robust zero-trust network policies and endpoint management.

-
Asset Management (approx. 15%): Build models to evaluate discounting and vendor deal structures, and measure IT service performance using clear KPIs and dashboards.

-
Global Team Support & Innovation (approx. 10%): Manage the operational challenges of a distributed global team and support local markets with tailored hardware strategies while maintaining a centralised global structure.
What you will bring:
-
8+ years of experience in an IT Operations, Procurement, or Systems Engineering role. You must have proven experience in a B2B SaaS company during a rapid growth phase and demonstrable experience supporting a global workforce.

-
Be an expert systems administrator with hands-on experience managing modern SaaS identity and access management tools and endpoint management solutions.

-
Data-driven strategist who can devise high-level strategy and is equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves to build a workflow or debug a technical issue. You can rally people around a clear vision and build pragmatic solutions.

-
Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical and financial concepts to a non-technical audience. You are a strong "consent" builder who can motivate people across departments to align on solutions.

jobs.title: Partnerships Internship
jobs.description:
At Deliverect, our API-first platform is revolutionizing commerce by providing a connected suite of on and off-premise solutions. We empower both the food and retail industries to expand their revenue and simplify their operations, creating seamless experiences for businesses to sell anywhere and deliver everywhere. Join us in this exciting journey, where your contributions will directly impact how businesses connect with their customers in a rapidly evolving global market.

Why this isn't your average internship
Deliverect connects third-party delivery platforms (like Uber Eats, Just Eat, Glovo, etc.) to restaurants' POS systems, automating the online order flow. We are a fast-growing SaaS company operating globally, simplifying online food delivery management so restaurants can focus on what they do best: crafting great food.

We are looking for an enthusiastic, tech-savvy, and detail-oriented Partner Trainee fluent in Italian to join our team in Spain. If you want to kickstart your career in the tech/SaaS industry and learn how a global partnership ecosystem works, this is your place!
Forget making coffee or printing PDFs. As our  Partner Trainee , you’ll sit in the driver’s seat of our expansion in Southern Europe. You’ll learn how a global SaaS company actually operates, solve real business challenges, and become the go-to contact for our partners.

If you want to fast-track your career in tech and see the direct impact of your work every single day, this is your launchpad.

🎯 What you’ll actually do (Your Impact):

-
Onboarding Support : Assist in the technical and operational onboarding of new partners (POS systems, delivery apps) in the Italian market.

-
Account Maintenance : Help monitor partner performance, troubleshoot basic integration issues, and ensure data accuracy in our systems.

-
Communication Link : Act as a day-to-day point of contact for Italian-speaking partners, answering queries and routing complex issues to the right internal teams.

-
Data & CRM Management : Keep our CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot) and internal databases up to date with partner information, contracts, and interaction logs.

-
Market Insights : Help research and map the local restaurant-tech ecosystem in Italy to identify new partnership opportunities.
🔥 Who you are (Your Superpowers):
- Fluent Italian Speaker: Native or bilingual fluency in Italian is non-negotiable. Strong professional English (and/or Spanish) is key, as we are a truly global team.

-
Tech-Curious: You don't need to write code! You just need a healthy curiosity about how modern software works and zero fear of learning new digital tools.

-
Fast Learner & Doer: You have a "get things done" attitude, strong organization skills, and love solving puzzles.

-
Background: Currently studying or recently graduated in Business, Hospitality, International Trade, IT, or a related field.

-
Passion for Tech & Food: A genuine interest in startups, food-tech, or the restaurant industry is a massive plus!
🎁 What’s in it for you?
💶 Competitive Financial Support: Paid internship with a monthly stipend to support you while you learn and grow with us.
📈 Real Career Rocket Fuel: We don't hire trainees just for temporary help. High performers regularly transition intofull-time permanent roles as we scale.
🎓 1-on-1 Mentorship: Work alongside industry experts who actually care about your professional growth and will coach you daily.
🌍 Vibrant International Vibe: Join a diverse, fun, and highly energetic multicultural team in Spain.
🏡 Hybrid Flexibility: Enjoy the best of both worlds with a mix of remote flexibility and collaborative office days.
🍕 Perks & Culture: Free coffee, daily office snacks, epic team-building events, and an environment where your ideas are actually heard.
